research_notes: [2026-08-23] Wave 3a: current pavilion pages plus official adoption inventory (stamped 01.08.2020). No English A–Z encyclopedia. No invented verify date.

do_not_list.name: African elephant
do_not_list.reason: Official Elephant Valley is a herd of Indian / Asian elephants (Shanti).

do_not_list.name: African lion
do_not_list.reason: Official adoption list names Asiatic lion, not African.

do_not_list.name: African penguin
do_not_list.reason: Official Penguin House is Humboldt’s penguin (Otylka).

do_not_list.name: Asian small-clawed otter
do_not_list.reason: Official adoption names Canadian otter and smooth-coated otter, not Asian small-clawed.

do_not_list.name: Koala
do_not_list.reason: Darwin Crater mentions wombats as koala relatives — no koala on site.

bonus_hunt.tagline: Prague bonus · Dja Reserve + African House + Lemur Island

challenges.text: Dja Reserve: who looks calmest in the gorilla family?
Rothschild’s giraffe: count the spots you can see on one neck.
Lemur Island: striped tail up or a long sit?
Hippo House: underwater, mud, or bank?
